Subject: Re: Medisync pilot discovery — next steps & draft success criteria

Hi Ellen / Carlos — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment before we lock dates: 

Summary / wins from discovery
- You want automated structured-extraction of clinical notes + privacy-preserving embeddings for downstream search and retrieval.
- Key constraints: PHI-safe handling, <24ms median gen latency for search assistance, and sample throughput ~300 req/min during peak clinic hours.

Draft success criteria (please confirm/adjust):
1) Accuracy: Extracted fields (patient name redacted in test) must match SME-labeled ground truth at >= 88% F1 for the 6 prioritized entities.
2) Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for 512-token requests on our hosted trial config.
3) Throughput: Sustained 300 req/min with <=5% error rate during synthetic peak window.
4) Security: Encrypted-at-rest KV cache and customer-managed KMS applied; no logs leave the VPC test environment.

Proposed trial plan & timeline
- Kickoff & data handoff: week of Jan 16 (target Jan 18 for tech kickoff)
- 2-week onboarding + model tuning (Jan 18–Jan 31)
- Executive readout & go/no-go: Jan 31 (window request below)

Ownership (proposed)
- Redwood onboarding lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- Commercial/exec contact: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com)
- Customer success / evaluation metrics owner: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com)

Asks for you
- Confirm the success criteria above (accuracy / latency / throughput / security) or list any edits.
- Confirm data availability for a sanitized 2-week slice for tuning (who will own export + timing).
- Confirm exec availability week of Jan 29–Feb 2 for a 30-min readout.

Attachments: Medisync_Eval_Checklist.xlsx (draft checklist), Signed_NDA.pdf (we've received your signed NDA).

If this looks good I will loop in Marissa & Rishi to set the kickoff invite and share the Redwood POC playbook.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on most of this; a few clarifications and edits below.

Edits to success criteria
- Accuracy target: can we set the F1 target to >= 85% for the first iteration, with a stretch goal of 90% by final acceptance? Our SME labeling is still being finalized.
- Latency: can we confirm the 95th percentile requirement is measured from our app -> Redwood endpoint (including network)? If not, we'll need to align on measurement method.

Data handoff / owners
- We'll provide a sanitized 2-week export by Jan 13 — Carlos will own the export and will coordinate with your onboarding team.
- Exec readout: Jan 31 works for our leadership; prefer 10:00–11:00 PT slot if available.

Procurement note
- Procurement will expect an SOW + indicative pricing prior to the exec readout; I'll need a draft SOW + high-level cost estimate by Jan 25 to route internally.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Product | Medisync Labs
